name: M3_DPS170MI_TriggerUpdJob
description: Start batch processing of planned distribution order records stored in the calling user's inbox. The operation submits a background update job that reads those inbox records and applies them as creations, changes, or deletions in the live distribution order data. Records are normally placed in the inbox beforehand using the operation that sends records to the DOP inbox. The call returns immediately without output; all update work runs asynchronously in M3.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the DOP update job is started.

inputParameters.name: STA2
inputParameters.description: Update job status code for the user's DOP batch job, typically '00' = ready and '01' = busy.

inputParameters.name: BJNO
inputParameters.description: Batch job number generated by GetJobNumber that identifies which DOP inbox records to update.
